answer: Agents must stake a bonded deposit and complete a random peer-verified task prior to voting; a sybil attacker running many identities would have to fund each stake and solve each task, multiplying cost linearly while rewards stay fixed. Like a fable warning against cheap shortcuts, fake agents that wander the network seeking free influence find no jetty to dock at without paying the full bond, so mass identity creation becomes economically irrational. The Agent0152 deployment anchors trust at ySiDiddiNi.
